rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something located at or relating to a physical or figurative edge.

example.english: This plan is only a marginal part of the company's business, so we will not invest many resources in it for now.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃只係公司邊緣業務，暫時唔會投入太多資源。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zi2 hai6 gung1 si1 bin1 jyun4 jip6 mou6 zaam6 si4 m4 wui5 tau4 jap6 taai3 do1 zi1 jyun4

rows.note: Use this when something is only just acceptable or barely meets the required standard.

example.english: The result of your report is marginal, but there are still many areas to improve.
example.traditional: 你份報告嘅成績勉強可以，但仲有好多地方要改善。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan2 bou3 gou3 ge3 sing4 zik1 min5 koeng5 ho2 ji5 daan6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 jiu3 goi2 sin6

rows.note: Use this specifically for land that produces little because its soil or conditions are poor.

example.english: This plot is marginal land, and whatever we plant yields poorly.
example.traditional: 呢塊地係瘦田，種乜都收成唔好。
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 dei6 hai6 sau3 tin4 zung3 mat1 dou1 sau1 sing4 m4 hou2
